items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Champion Jack Dupree in a list of artists at an event; the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or knowledge of Dupree.

ctx.x: Yes. Yeah, I know about those events, most of those events -
PS: No, I'm talking about one specific one, they had that one where they got Bud Powell and Nelson Williams and Champion Jack Dupree -
No. I had heard about it but I wasn't in it.
